    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4241,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4240,
            "description": "Victoria. I will meet with Premier Eby and speak about our shared priorities."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4242,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4240,
            "description": "Hamilton and Niagara Falls. I will speak about how I will protect their manufacturing industries."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4243,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4240,
            "description": "Québec City. I will reiterate my respect for provincial jurisdiction."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4244,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4240,
            "description": "Brampton and Scarborough. I will speak to their concerns about crime."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4251,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4250,
            "description": "Canada is an immigrant nation. Our diversity is what makes us strong. We should continue welcoming as many new Canadians as possible and invest into resources to help new immigrants integrate into our communities."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4252,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4250,
            "description": "The rapid growth of the temporary worker program is concerning considering the allegations of abuse and exploitation. We should restrict this program to address these concerns, instead focusing on welcoming refugees and supporting family reunification."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4253,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4250,
            "description": "Current immigration levels are unsustainable and have put a strain on housing, infrastructure, and public services. I will place a cap on temporary residents and reduce permanent resident admissions to ease that strain."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4254,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4250,
            "description": "We need to reform the system to attract the best talent in the world to build our economy. We should make sure that the immigrants we welcome are net contributors to our society."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4261,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4260,
            "description": "My plan includes a well-deserved tax cut for the middle class, lowering the lowest tax bracket to 14%."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4262,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4260,
            "description": "It’s time to let Canadians keep more of what they earn. I will drop the lowest tax bracket to 12%."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4263,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4260,
            "description": "We don’t need any tax cuts right now. We’re heading into difficult times with the Trump tariffs, and we should use that money to support people who may lose their jobs from the economic disruption."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4264,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4260,
            "description": "I will raise the basic personal allowance to $19,500 and remove GST from essentials like energy bills."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4271,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4270,
            "description": "Housing is a provincial responsibility. I am calling on the Premiers to step up and find solutions on this issue."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4272,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4270,
            "description": "We have a massive housing shortage. We need to throw everything we can at this issue, including working with municipalities to relax zoning bylaws, investing to catalyze the private sector into action, exploring ways to increase construction productivity such as modular housing, and cutting the tax burden on home builders."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4273,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4270,
            "description": "The housing market is too distorted to operate efficiently. We need to remove burdensome regulations, speed up approvals, cut taxes on home building, and slash development charges. These reforms will unleash private investment and make the housing market function properly once again."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4274,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4270,
            "description": "Building more housing is not enough if the houses are not affordable. We need to lead the charge with large public investments into deeply affordable homes. We need to restrict foreign and corporate ownership of housing and provide stronger support for renters."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4281,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4280,
            "description": "Spend less, invest more. I will emphasize making a distinction between operating and capital budgets, and pledge to balance the operating budget by the end of my term."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4282,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4280,
            "description": "I will balance the operating budget by the end of the first year in office without any new taxes by making the government more efficient."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4283,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4280,
            "description": "I will focus on making investments that will grow the economy, allowing us to balance the budget without service cuts."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4284,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4280,
            "description": "I will both balance the budget and protect the funding of our public services. This will be made possible by a wealth tax on the ultra-wealthy, increased taxes on the profits of large corporations, and cracking down on tax evasion."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4291,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4290,
            "description": "What Israel is doing in Gaza is a genocide. We should be putting maximum pressure on the Israeli government to reach a permanent ceasefire and end their illegal occupation of Palestinian land."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4292,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4290,
            "description": "Israel must allow humanitarian aid to enter Gaza. I support an arms embargo and will work with our international partners to work towards a two-state solution."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4293,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4290,
            "description": "This is a far away issue that should not be of interest to Canadians. We have far more important issues to focus on, such as affordability and the economy."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4294,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4290,
            "description": "Israel has a right to defend itself. As the only democracy in the Middle East, its neighbours are a constant threat to it. To the Israeli people, I stand with you."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4301,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4300,
            "description": "Yes. I will work with the provinces and First Nations to simplify the approval process and use emergency powers to streamline the federal side of that equation."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4302,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4300,
            "description": "We need to focus on building up our LNG infrastructure, and that includes gas pipelines. LNG poses no spill risk and burns clean."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4303,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4300,
            "description": "I do not support new pipelines. The Trans Mountain pipeline remains below capacity. The world is shifting away from oil and gas, making a new pipeline an imprudent investment. We should be focusing on becoming a clean energy superpower."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4304,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4300,
            "description": "We need to do everything we can to expand the market access for our oil. This is an urgent matter of national and economic security. I will do everything in my power to get these projects moving immediately."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4311,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4310,
            "description": "Every dollar spent on weapons is a dollar not spent to invest into our economy. I will ensure the military has the necessary capabilities for our defence but no more."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4312,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4310,
            "description": "I will fund investments into our armed forces, including raising soldiers’ pay and securing the Arctic. This will grow the military budget to meet our NATO commitments of 2% of GDP by 2030."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4313,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4310,
            "description": "We live in an increasingly dangerous world. We need large investments into the military, including 3.5% of GDP for personnel and procurement and an additional 1.5% of GDP for building infrastructure to support our troops from coast to coast to coast."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4314,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4310,
            "description": "With the threats from down south, it has become clear that we must become more self-reliant for our defence. We will aim to maximize domestic procurement and cooperate with the ReArm Europe plan."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4321,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4320,
            "description": "I will attack the Conservatives for their plans to cut the public service while quietly including similar cuts in my fiscal plan."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4322,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4320,
            "description": "The public service has been growing too quickly. I will slow the growth of the public sector, and improve productivity through the use of AI."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4323,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4320,
            "description": "I will defend the public service. These are hard-working men and women who help deliver the programs that millions of Canadians depend upon. Instead of outsourcing work to contractors, I will shift the work back to our civil servants. Let there be no doubt that the Conservatives will worsen service and cut essential programs."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4324,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4320,
            "description": "We need to spend less and invest more. I will introduce large cuts to the government bureaucracy, freeing up funds to catalyze private investment and economic growth."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4331,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4330,
            "description": "I’ll take the fight to Poilievre. I will hammer him on his populist approach to politics and compare him with Donald Trump."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4332,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4330,
            "description": "I will stay cool and collected, focusing on fending off attacks from my opponents."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4333,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4330,
            "description": "I will use the debate as a platform to communicate my economic plan. I don’t just talk; I have a strong record for managing economies."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4334,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4330,
            "description": "I will make a full-throated defense of our valued social programs. From childcare, to dentalcare, to pharmacare, we Liberals have built a more equal and fair society."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4341,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4340,
            "description": "I will focus my efforts broadly across the country."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4342,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4340,
            "description": "I will campaign in Edmonton, Calgary, and Saskatoon. Alberta and Saskatchewan may be conservative provinces, but we have a chance for a breakthrough in the cities."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4343,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4340,
            "description": "I will campaign in the Maritimes. This region is rich in seats for its population, and we need to lock them down."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4344,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4340,
            "description": "The Greater Toronto Area. The suburbs are always in contention."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4351,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4350,
            "description": "I will cancel my campaign events and fly to Vancouver to offer my condolences to the victims and their families."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4352,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4350,
            "description": "I will call for stronger gun control to prevent attacks like these. If even one such event can be prevented, we have a responsibility to act."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4353,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4350,
            "description": "We need more funds for mental health care to prevent tragedies like this from occurring."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4354,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4350,
            "description": "The culprit was known to police. He should have been locked up before he could cause so much harm."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4361,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4360,
            "description": "My friends, love is better than anger. Hope is better than fear. Optimism is better than despair. So let us be loving, hopeful and optimistic. And we’ll change the world."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4362,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4360,
            "description": "We don’t need chaos, we need calm. We don’t need anger, we need an adult, and we need action. Because we need to fight, we need to protect, and we need to build. Elbows up!"
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4363,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4360,
            "description": "Pierre Poilievre’s war on “woke” is dangerous and has no place in Canada. He is stoking fears and resentment, entrenching division, and legitimizing extreme positions. We need to send a clear message that this divisive American approach is not welcome here."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer",
        "pk": 4364,
        "fields": {
            "question": 4360,
            "description": "Your dreams are the same as mine. A country that is safe, where people are kind to each other and get along, where everyone has a place to call home, and people can be who they want to be. Our children should be able to dream about a positive future, not worry about an economic crisis. With everyone pulling together, we will emerge stronger."
        }
    }
]

campaignTrail_temp.answer_feedback_json = [
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5011,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4011,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Your addition to the cabinet rejuvenates the party but is unable to save Trudeau’s reputation. He resigns, and you are slightly tarnished for being in government with him for the short stint."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5012,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4012,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Good call. The pressure on Trudeau continues to build, and he announces his resignation in the New Year."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5021,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4021,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "The interview is extremely hostile. There’s no way you got any positive impression among their audience."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5022,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4022,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "The interview goes fairly well, but Barton is adversarial and does not give you an easy time."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5023,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4023,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Québec appreciates you putting them first, but your weak French impedes your ability to communicate clearly."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5024,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4024,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Going on an American show nets you some derision, but many Canadians watch more American TV than Canadian, and this allows you to reach them."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5031,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4031,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "This balances the need for a clear dismissal of the idea without further damaging Canada-US relations."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5032,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4032,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "This may appeal to some in your globalist bubble, but your supporters are outraged at the idea of integration with the Trumpian United States."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5033,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4033,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Trump continues to bring up the idea, and your supporters demand a strong response."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5034,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4034,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "This is a strong answer, but risks escalating the situation."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5041,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4041,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Workers in export industries are fearful of losing their jobs, and this does nothing to alleviate their fears."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5042,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4042,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "This helps you ride the wave of Canadian patriotism sweeping through the country."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5043,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4043,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Canadians are happy to see you give this issue your full attention."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5044,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4044,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Caving to Trump makes you look weak, and tariffs end up going into effect anyway."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5051,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4051,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Journalists retrieve company documents that show the decision was approved in October, long before you left the company."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5052,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4052,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "You’re dragging this race into the mud."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5053,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4053,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Nevertheless, this still leaves Canadians feeling concerned."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5061,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4061,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "This would be a solid message, if it were true. Unfortunately, Canada is a relatively small exporter of semiconductors."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5062,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4062,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Aluminium and fertilizer producers are worried that they will pay the price for the trade war. However, this stance does make you look strong."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5063,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4063,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "This is a sensible response, but some are worried that this time is different."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5064,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4064,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "The insinuation appeals to your background as a banker."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5071,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4071,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Your experience in both the public and private sectors sets you apart from your rivals."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5072,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4072,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "You’re leaning into an outsider image. This is refreshing to many, but may disappoint those who supported many of Trudeau’s reforms."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5073,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4073,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Your focus on the economy synergizes with professional experience."
        }

        "fields": {
            "answer": 4333,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Your long detailed answers delivered in your monotone voice fail to capture the imagination of Canadians."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5334,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4334,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Poilievre ties you with the Trudeau government, he is considered to have won the debates."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5351,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4351,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "This is a standard, non-political response to a tragedy like this."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5352,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4352,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "It was a vehicle-ramming attack, not a shooting. You are criticized for blatantly politicizing the situation."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5353,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4353,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "The culprit was already under mental health supervision with no indication of being a public safety risk."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5354,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4354,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "He was also never previously charged with any crime. Your comment draws the ire of civil rights groups."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5361,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4361,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "A touching homage to the late Jack Layton’s last letter to Canadians. Good luck tomorrow."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5362,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4362,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "You’re pitching yourself as the statesman that Canada needs. Good luck tomorrow!"
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5363,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4363,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "Hopefully these attacks on Poilievre bear fruit. Good luck tomorrow."
        }
    },
    {
        "model": "campaign_trail.answer_feedback",
        "pk": 5364,
        "fields": {
            "answer": 4364,
            "candidate": 300,
            "answer_feedback": "What an optimistic message! Good luck tomorrow!"
        }
    }
]

let observerRunning = false;
let processedNodes = new Set();
const scrollableElementIds = ["overall_result", "state_result", "state_info", "main_content_area", "final_results_description"];
let campaign_sign = null;

async function handleMutations(mutationsList, observer) {
    if (observerRunning) return;
    observerRunning = true;

    // stop observing
    observer.disconnect();

    // addScrollbar
    for (const scrollableElementId of scrollableElementIds) {
        const overallResult = document.getElementById(scrollableElementId);
        if (overallResult && !processedNodes.has(overallResult)) {
            overallResult.style.overflow = 'auto';
            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('#view_electoral_map, #answer_select_button, #ok_button, #final_election_map_button');
            const handleClick = () => {
                overallResult.style.overflow = 'auto';
            };
            buttons.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', handleClick));
            processedNodes.add(overallResult);
        }
    }

    // change campaign sign
    if (campaign_sign) {
        const oldSign = document.getElementById('campaign_sign');
        if (oldSign) {
            const newSign = document.createElement('img');
            newSign.src = campaign_sign;
            newSign.style.height = "65%";
            oldSign.replaceWith(newSign)
        }
    }

    const pvswitcher_button = document.getElementById("pvswitcher");
    if (pvswitcher_button) {
        if (pvswitcher_button.textContent === "PV Estimate") {
            pvswitcher_button.textContent = "Popular Vote Estimate";
        } else if (pvswitcher_button.textContent === "Switch to State Estimate") {
            pvswitcher_button.textContent = "Riding Estimate";
        }
    }

    const replaceUpTo = "Electoral Votes".length;

    // replace "electoral votes" with "seats"
    const ev_button = document.getElementById("ev_est");
    const seat_text = "Seat Estimate";
    if (ev_button && ev_button.textContent !== seat_text) {
        ev_button.textContent = seat_text;
    }

    const state_info = document.getElementById("state_info")
    if (state_info) {
        const state_info_header = state_info.children[0];
        if (state_info_header && state_info_header.textContent !== "RIDING SUMMARY") {
            state_info_header.textContent = "RIDING SUMMARY";
        }

        const ev_number = state_info.children[3];
        if (ev_number && ev_number.textContent.slice(0, replaceUpTo) === "Electoral Votes") {
            ev_number.textContent = "Seats" + ev_number.textContent.slice(replaceUpTo);
        }
    }

    const overall_result = document.getElementById("overall_result");
    if (overall_result) {
        const overall_result_header = overall_result.children[0];
        if (overall_result_header && overall_result_header.textContent === "ELECTORAL VOTES") {
            overall_result_header.textContent = "OVERALL RESULTS";
        }
    }

    const state_result = document.getElementById("state_result");
    if (state_result) {
        const state_result_header = state_result.children[0];
        if (state_result_header && state_result_header.textContent !== "RIDING RESULTS") {
            state_result_header.textContent = "RIDING RESULTS";
        }
        const state_result_text = state_result.children[1];
        if (state_result_text) {
            if (state_result_text.textContent === "Click on a state to view final results.") {
                state_result_text.textContent = "Click on a riding to view final results.";
            } else if (state_result_text.textContent === "Click on a state to view detailed results (once returns for that state arrive).") {
                state_result_text.textContent = "Click on a riding to view detailed results (once returns for that riding arrive).";
            } else if (state_result_text.textContent === "Returns for this state are not yet available!") {
                state_result_text.textContent = "Returns for this riding are not yet available!";
            }
        }
        const state_result_evs = state_result.children[2];
        if (state_result_evs && state_result_evs.textContent.slice(0, replaceUpTo) === "Electoral Votes") {
            state_result_evs.textContent = "Seats" + state_result_evs.textContent.slice(replaceUpTo);
        }
    }

    const final_results = document.getElementsByClassName("final_results_table");
    if (final_results && final_results.length > 0) {
        replaceTableHeaders(final_results[0])
    }

    const overall_details = document.querySelectorAll("#overall_election_details, #state_result_data_summary");
    for (const table_container of overall_details) {
        replaceTableHeaders(table_container.children[1])
    }

    const state_results_button = document.getElementById("state_results_button");
    if (state_results_button && state_results_button.textContent === "Results by State") {
        state_results_button.textContent = "Results by Riding";      
    }

    const headers = document.getElementsByClassName("title_h3");
    for (const header of headers) {
        if (header.textContent === "Election Results and Data by State") {
            header.textContent = "Election Results and Data by Riding";
        }
    }

    const sort_tab = document.getElementById("sort_tab");
    if (sort_tab && sort_tab.querySelector('option[value="2"]')) {
        const queryTwo = sort_tab.querySelector('option[value="2"]');
        if (queryTwo) {
            queryTwo.remove();
        }
    }
    if (sort_tab && sort_tab.querySelector('option[value="3"]')) {
        const queryThree = sort_tab.querySelector('option[value="3"]');
        if (queryThree.textContent === "Closest States") {
            queryThree.textContent = "Closest Ridings"
        }
    }

    const sort_tab_area = document.getElementById("sort_tab_area");
    if (sort_tab_area) {
        const sort_text = sort_tab_area.firstElementChild.firstChild;
        if (sort_text.textContent.startsWith("View states by:")) {
            sort_text.textContent = "View ridings by:" + sort_text.textContent.slice("View ridings by:".length);
        }
    }

    const state_tab_area = document.getElementById("state_tab_area");
    if (state_tab_area) {
        const state_text = state_tab_area.firstElementChild.firstChild;
        if (state_text.textContent.startsWith("Select a state:")) {
            state_text.textContent = "Select a riding:" + state_text.textContent.slice("Select a riding:".length);
        }
    }

    // Resume observing
    observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    observerRunning = false;
}

function replaceTableHeaders(table) {
    if (table && table.firstElementChild && table.firstElementChild.firstElementChild) {
        const table_headers_container = table.firstElementChild.firstElementChild;
        const candidate_header = table_headers_container.children[0];
        if (candidate_header.textContent === "Candidate") {
            candidate_header.textContent = "Party";

        const ev_header = table_headers_container.children[1];
        if (ev_header.textContent === "Electoral Votes") {
            ev_header.textContent = "Seats";

        const ev_header_alt = table_headers_container.children[3];
        if (ev_header_alt.textContent === "Electoral Votes") {
            ev_header_alt.textContent = "Seats";
        }
    }
}

function getTooltips(str) {
    let matches = [];

    tooltipList.forEach((tooltip, index) => {
        // Adjust the regex to match searchString potentially surrounded by “ and followed by optional punctuation
       let regex = new RegExp(`(?<=\\b|\\s|^|“)${tooltip.searchString}(?=[.,;!?]?\\b|\\s|”|$)`, 'g');


        let match;
        while ((match = regex.exec(str)) !== null) {
            matches.push({
                start: match.index + (match[0].startsWith('“') ? 1 : 0), // Adjust for potential starting “
                end: match.index + match[0].length - (match[0].endsWith('”') ? 1 : 0) - (match[2] ? 1 : 0), 
                tooltipIndex: index
            });
        }
    });

    // Sort by starting position; if two start at the same position, longer match comes first
    matches.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || b.end - b.start - (a.end - a.start));

    // Filter out overlaps
    for (let i = 0; i < matches.length - 1; ) {
        if (matches[i + 1].start < matches[i].end) {
            matches.splice(i + 1, 1); // Remove the next match since it overlaps
        } else {
            i++; // Move to next match
        }
    }

    return matches;
}

function applyTooltips(str) {
    const matches = getTooltips(str);
    let result = '';
    let lastIndex = 0;

    matches.forEach(match => {
        const tooltip = tooltipList[match.tooltipIndex];
        result += str.slice(lastIndex, match.start);
        result += `<span class='mytooltip'>${tooltip.searchString}<span class='mytooltiptext'>${tooltip.explanationText}</span></span>`;
        lastIndex = match.end;
    });

    result += str.slice(lastIndex); // Add the remainder of the original string
    return result;
}

function applyTooltipsToObject(obj) {
    for (let key in obj) {
        if (typeof obj[key] === 'string') {
            obj[key] = applyTooltips(obj[key]);
        } else if (typeof obj[key] === 'object') {
            applyTooltipsToObject(obj[key]); // Recursive call
        }
    }
}

toTime = (seconds) => {
    var date = new Date(null);
    date.setSeconds(seconds);
    return date.toISOString().substr(11, 8);
}

function nextTrack() {
    console.log("next track")
    e = campaignTrail_temp
    audio = $("#campaigntrailmusic")[0];
    tracklist_length = e.soundtracks[e.selectedSoundtrack].tracklist.length;
    if (tracklist_length == 1) {
        audio.currentTime = 0
        audio.play()
        return
    }
    let selected = Number(document.querySelector('input[name="trackSelector"]:checked').value);
    var newSel;
    if (audio.shuffle) {
        newSel = Math.floor(Math.random() * (tracklist_length - 1));
        if (newSel >= selected) {
            newSel += 1;
        }
    } else {
        newSel = clamp(selected + 1, tracklist_length - 1, 0);
    }
    let buttons = Array.from(document.getElementById("trackSel").children).filter(f => {
        return f.tagName == "LABEL"
    }).map(f => f.children[0])
    buttons[newSel].click()
}

generateTime = () => {
    // Get the audio element
    e = campaignTrail_temp
    var audio = document.getElementById("campaigntrailmusic");

    timeTracker = document.createElement("div");
    timeTracker.style = `
      text-align:left;
      border-style:solid;
      border-width:3px;
      height:180px;
      width:200px;
      background-color:#999999;
      float:right;
      padding: 10px;
    `
    $("#trackSelParent")[0].prepend(timeTracker);
    $("#trackSelParent")[0].prepend(document.createElement("br"));

    // Create a new element to display the current position of the audio
    var positionDisplay = document.createElement("gg");
    positionDisplay.id = "position-display";

    // Create a new slider element to change the time
    var timeSlider = document.createElement("input");
    timeSlider.type = "range";
    timeSlider.min = 0;
    timeSlider.max = 1;
    timeSlider.step = 0.001;
    timeSlider.value = 0;
    timeSlider.style.width = "200px";
    timeSlider.id = "time-slider";

    var pausePlay = document.createElement("button");
    pausePlay.id = "position-display";
    pausePlay.innerHTML = "<b>Pause</b>"
    pausePlay.style.width = "100%";
    pausePlay.style.margin = "2px";
    pausePlay.addEventListener("click", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        updatePositionDisplay();
        let audio = document.getElementById("campaigntrailmusic");
        if (audio.paused) {
            audio.play();
            event.target.innerHTML = "<b>Pause</b>";
            return;
        }
        audio.pause();
        event.target.innerHTML = "<b>Play</b>";
        return;
    })

    var shuffle = document.createElement("button");
    shuffle.id = "shuffle-button";
    shuffle.innerHTML = audio.shuffle ? "<b>Unshuffle</b>" : "<b>Shuffle</b>";
    shuffle.style.width = "100%";
    shuffle.style.margin = "2px";
    shuffle.addEventListener("click", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        audio = document.getElementById("campaigntrailmusic");
        if (audio.shuffle) {
            audio.shuffle = false;
            event.target.innerHTML = "<b>Shuffle</b>"
            return;
        }
        audio.shuffle = true;
        event.target.innerHTML = "<b>Unshuffle</b>"
    })

    var skipButton = document.createElement("button");
    skipButton.id = "skip-button";
    skipButton.innerHTML = "<b>Skip</b>"
    skipButton.style.width = "50%";
    skipButton.style.margin = "2px"; // Add margin
    skipButton.addEventListener("click", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        nextTrack();
    })

    var loopButton = document.createElement("button");
    loopButton.id = "loop-button";
    loopButton.innerHTML = audio.loopEnabled ? "<b>Unloop</b>" : "<b>Loop</b>";  // Check the initial loop state
    loopButton.style.width = "50%";  // Match the width with skipButton
    loopButton.style.margin = "2px";
    loopButton.addEventListener("click", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        audio = document.getElementById("campaigntrailmusic");
        audio.loopEnabled = !audio.loopEnabled;
        audio.loop = audio.loopEnabled;  // Set the audio's loop property
        event.target.innerHTML = audio.loopEnabled ? "<b>Unloop</b>" : "<b>Loop</b>";  // Toggle the button text
    });

    var buttonContainer = document.createElement("div");
    buttonContainer.style.display = "flex"; // Makes children inline
    buttonContainer.style.justifyContent = "space-between";
    skipButton.style.flex = "1"; // Makes it take up equal space
    skipButton.style.marginRight = "5px"; // Adds some space between the buttons

    loopButton.style.marginRight = "0px";

    buttonContainer.appendChild(skipButton);
    buttonContainer.appendChild(loopButton);

    var volumeLabel = document.createElement("gg");
    volumeLabel.id = "volume-label";
    volumeLabel.innerHTML = "<br><b>Volume: </b>"

    var volumeSlider = document.createElement("input");
    volumeSlider.type = "range";
    volumeSlider.min = 0;
    volumeSlider.max = 1;
    volumeSlider.step = 0.001;
    volumeSlider.value = 0;
    volumeSlider.style.width = "200px";
    volumeSlider.id = "volume-slider";

    volumeSlider.value = audio.volume;

    timeTracker.appendChild(pausePlay);
    timeTracker.appendChild(shuffle);
    timeTracker.appendChild(buttonContainer);
    timeTracker.appendChild(document.createElement("br"));
    timeTracker.appendChild(positionDisplay);
    timeTracker.appendChild(timeSlider);
    timeTracker.appendChild(volumeLabel);
    timeTracker.appendChild(volumeSlider);

    updatePositionDisplay();

    // Function to update the position display
    function updatePositionDisplay() {
        positionDisplay.innerHTML = "<b>Time:</b> " + toTime(audio.currentTime) + "<br>";
        timeSlider.value = audio.duration ? audio.currentTime / audio.duration : 0;
    }

    // Function to change the time of the audio
    function changeTime() {
        positionDisplay.innerHTML = "<b>Time:</b> " + toTime(audio.currentTime) + "<br>";
        audio.currentTime = timeSlider.value * audio.duration;
    }

    updateVolume = event => {
        audio.volume = event.target.value;
    }

    // Update the position display and slider every second
    setInterval(updatePositionDisplay, 1000);

    // Listen for changes to the time slider and change the time of the audio
    timeSlider.addEventListener("input", changeTime);
    volumeSlider.addEventListener("input", updateVolume)
}

function newMusicPlayer(soundtracks) {
    campaignTrail_temp.soundtracks = soundtracks;
    trackSel = document.createElement("div");
    trackSel.id = "trackSelParent"
    let z = `<div id='trackSel' style="text-align:left;border-style:solid;border-width:3px;overflow-y: scroll;overflow-x: hidden;height:200px; width:500px;background-color:#999999;float:right;">`
    z += `<b><select id='selectSoundtrack'><option value='` + soundtracks[e.selectedSoundtrack].name + `'>` + soundtracks[e.selectedSoundtrack].name + "</option>"
    for (i in soundtracks) {
        if (soundtracks[e.selectedSoundtrack] != soundtracks[i]) {
            z += `<option value='` + soundtracks[i].name + `'>` + soundtracks[i].name + `</option>`
        }
    }
    z += `</select></b><br><br>`
    // <label><input type="radio" name="option" value="option1">Option 1</label><br>
    for (i in soundtracks[e.selectedSoundtrack].tracklist) {
        let a = soundtracks[e.selectedSoundtrack].tracklist[i]
        let b = `<label><input class="trackSelector" type="radio" name="trackSelector" value="` + i + `">` + a.name + `</label><br>`
        z += b
    }
    z += "</div><br><br>"
    trackSel.innerHTML = z

    // select correct song

    musicBox.appendChild(trackSel);
    Array.from(document.getElementById("trackSel").children).filter(f => {
        return f.tagName == "LABEL"
    }).map(f => f.children[0])[0].checked = true

    // set soundtrack changer

    soundtrackSelector = document.getElementById("selectSoundtrack")
    soundtrackSelector.onchange = function () {
        for (i in soundtracks) {
            if (soundtracks[i].name == soundtrackSelector.value) {
                e.selectedSoundtrack = i
                break
            }
        }
        document.getElementById("trackSelParent").remove()
        newMusicPlayer(soundtracks)
    }

    var matches = document.querySelectorAll('.trackSelector');

    for (match in matches) {
        matches[match].onchange = function () {
            audio = $("#campaigntrailmusic")[0];
            audio.src = soundtracks[e.selectedSoundtrack].tracklist[this.value].url
            audio.currentTime = 0
        }
    }

    musicBox.children[2].loop = false
    musicBox.children[2].src = soundtracks[e.selectedSoundtrack].tracklist[0].url

    musicBox.children[2].onended = nextTrack;

    for (w = 0; w < 7; w++) {
        document.getElementById("trackSelParent").appendChild(document.createElement("br"))
    }

    generateTime();
}

clamp = function (a, max, min, overflow = true) {
    if (overflow) {
        return a > max ? min : a < min ? max : a;
    }
    return a > max ? max : a < min ? min : a;
}

}

function charting(chartType){
    // Select the element to keep
    let mapFooter = $('#map_footer');
  
    // Temporarily detach the element from DOM (it preserves bound events and data)
    mapFooter.detach();
  
    // Cache the current content of #game_window
    let cachedContent = $('#game_window').html();
  
    $("#game_window").html('<div class="game_header">\t<h2>NEW CAMPAIGN TRAIL</h2>\t</div>\t<div id="main_content_area">\t<div id="results_container"><br>  <div id="title_container"><h3 class="campaign-title">Election Charts:</h3><button id="voteShareBarChart">Vote Share Bar Chart</button><button id="seatBarChart">Seat Bar Chart</button><button id="houseOfCommons">House of Commons</button></div><br><div id="chartcontainer"><figure class="highcharts-figure"><div id="myChart"></div></figure></div></div></div><div id="container"></div>');

    $("#game_window").append(mapFooter);
    $('#map_footer button').prop('disabled', false);

    var container = document.getElementById("title_container");
    var voteShareBarChartButton = document.getElementById("voteShareBarChart");
    var seatBarChartButton = document.getElementById("seatBarChart");
    var houseOfCommonsButton = document.getElementById("houseOfCommons");

    container.style.display = "flex";
    container.style.alignItems = "center";
    container.style.justifyContent = "center";

    voteShareBarChartButton.style.marginLeft = "10px";
    seatBarChartButton.style.marginLeft = "10px";
    houseOfCommonsButton.style.marginLeft = "10px";

    if (chartType === "voteShareBar") {
        voteShareBarChartButton.disabled = true;
    } else if (chartType === "seatBar") {
        seatBarChartButton.disabled = true;
    } else if (chartType === "seating") {
        houseOfCommonsButton.disabled = true;
    }

    $("#map_footer").css({
        position: "relative",
        zIndex: "9999"
    });
    $("#voteShareBarChart").click(function() {
        charting("voteShareBar");
    });
    $("#seatBarChart").click(function() {
        charting("seatBar");
    });
    $("#houseOfCommons").click(function() {
        charting("seating");
    });

    // Add an event listener to all buttons in #map_footer, excluding #chart_button
    $('#map_footer button:not(#chart_button)').on('click', function() {
        // Check if #chartcontainer exists in the current #game_window
        if ($('#game_window #chartcontainer').length > 0) {
            // If it does, restore the cached content
            let mapFooter = $('#map_footer');
            mapFooter.detach();
            $('#game_window').html(cachedContent);
            $("#game_window").append(mapFooter);

            // Enable all buttons
            $('#map_footer button').prop('disabled', false);

            $(this).prop('disabled', true);
        }
    });

    setTimeout(function() { executeWithRetry(Chartbuilder, chartType); }, 100);
};

function Chartbuilder(type) {
    const chartButton = document.getElementById("chart_button");
    chartButton.disabled = true;

    if (type === "seating") {
        var LibSeats = (e.final_overall_results.find((r) => r.candidate === 300));
        var ConSeats = (e.final_overall_results.find((r) => r.candidate === 301));
        var NdpSeats = (e.final_overall_results.find((r) => r.candidate === 302));
        var GrnSeats = (e.final_overall_results.find((r) => r.candidate === 303));
        var BlcSeats = (e.final_overall_results.find((r) => r.candidate === 304));
        var PpcSeats = (e.final_overall_results.find((r) => r.candidate === 306));
        var OthSeats = (e.final_overall_results.find((r) => r.candidate === 305));

        var seatData = [
            ['New Democratic Party', NdpSeats.electoral_votes, '#F4A460', 'NDP'],
            ['Green Party', GrnSeats.electoral_votes, '#99C955', 'GPC'],
            ['Liberal Party', LibSeats.electoral_votes, '#EA6D6A', 'LPC'],
            ['Bloc Québécois', BlcSeats.electoral_votes, '#87CEFA', 'BQ'],
            ['Others', OthSeats.electoral_votes, '#808080', 'Others'],
            ['Conservative Party', ConSeats.electoral_votes, '#6495ED', 'CPC'],
            ['People\'s Party', PpcSeats.electoral_votes, '#6F5D9A', 'PPC']
        ];
        seatData = seatData.filter((entry) => { return entry[1] > 0; });
        parliamentChart(seatData);
    } 
    else if (type === "voteShareBar") {
        barChart("2025", "share");
    }
    else if (type === "seatBar") {
        barChart("2025", "seats");
    }
    
    var div = document.getElementById('chartcontainer');
    div.style.border = 'medium double';
    div.style.backgroundColor = '#f9f9f9';
    div.style.borderColor = '#c9c9c9';

    var element = document.querySelector('.highcharts-background');
    if (element) { // Check if element exists before trying to remove it
        element.remove();
    }
}

function loadScript(url, callback) {
    var script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = url;
    script.onload = callback;
  
    document.head.appendChild(script);
}

function loadScripts() {
    if (!e.initDC) {
        e.initDC = true

        loadScript('https://code.highcharts.com/highcharts.js', function() {
            loadScript('https://code.highcharts.com/modules/item-series.js', function() {
                loadScript('https://code.highcharts.com/modules/accessibility.js', function() {});
            });
        });
    }
}

function getVoteShare(totalPopularVote, party) {
    return Math.round(((e.final_overall_results.find((r) => r.candidate === party).popular_votes/totalPopularVote))*1000)/10;
}

function getSeatNumber(party) {
    return (e.final_overall_results.find((r) => r.candidate === party)).electoral_votes;
}

function setImage(url) {
    if (url == '' || url == null) return;
    let interval = setInterval(function() {
        img = document.getElementsByClassName("person_image")[0];
        if (img != null) {
            img.src = url;
            clearInterval(interval);
        }
    }, 10);
}

function executeWithRetry(fn, ...args) {
    const maxRetries = 20;
    const delayMs = 100;

    for (let retry = 0; retry < maxRetries; retry++) {
        try {
            fn(...args);
            return;
        } catch (err) {
            console.log(err);
            if (retry < maxRetries - 1) {
            setTimeout(() => {}, delayMs);
            }
        }
    }
}
